name: BEN_WV_PRTN_RSN_CTFN_PTIP_F
description: BEN_WV_PRTN_RSN_CTFN_PTIP_F identifies the certification that may be required when a person waives coverage in a plan type in program for a specified reason as opposed to actively electing a "Waive" plan.  For example, if an  eligible person waives participation in all medical plans for the reason of "have other coverage", he or she may be required to provide proof of coverage in an external plan.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
